yourPDF · Good to know

Privacy, without the fine-print maze

Updated 20 October 2026.

Your documents

The PDF and image tools in this release process selected documents locally in your browser. Application code does not upload document contents, filenames or previews to a server. Processing libraries are served from this same website. No external font, analytics, ad or session-replay services are included.

Workspace lifetime

Files and results are held in tab memory so you can continue into another tool. Start over, refresh or close the page to clear the workspace. Downloaded files remain on your device. Browser memory, caching and downloaded-file handling are controlled by your browser.

Website requests

The hosting provider receives ordinary page and asset requests, potentially including IP address, browser information and access-control information. Its own policies govern infrastructure logs. This differs from uploading your documents. Application code does not set cookies or persist documents to browser storage.

Future changes

If a later tool needs a server upload or tracking, that behavior must be disclosed before it happens. This release does not offer server processing.
